patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video with a semi-transparent overlay for text, creating an immersive initial experience.
Alternating background colors (video, solid blue, white, light grey) are used to clearly delineate distinct content sections down the page.
A playful, hand-drawn display font is used for key headings and decorative accents, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A vibrant, dominant royal blue is consistently applied as a primary brand color for full-width section backgrounds and interactive elements, establishing a strong visual identity.
The hero video background scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect as the user scrolls down the page.
The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, maintaining its original size and background color.
Large, high-quality, editorial-style photography is used as full-width backgrounds or prominent feature images to showcase products and the baking process.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero is used with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability, and the video content itself scrolls at a slower rate than the page, creating a parallax depth effect.
The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining its visual style and background.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Features oversized, playful display headings (often uppercase) that contrast with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and functional elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and image containers, maintaining a soft but not overly rounded aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The distinctive combination of high-quality, editorial-style photography with a playful, hand-drawn typography and illustration style, all anchored by a bold, consistent royal blue, creates a unique brand personality that feels both sophisticated and approachable. The parallax hero video adds a dynamic, immersive touch.
